assertions.name: qdeformed_CG_exact
assertions.source: [3]_q^2 = [1]_q + [3]_q + [5]_q holds identically in q (symbolic expansion), so the color-pair space T1 (x) T1 decomposes with quantum dimensions [1],[3],[5] — the q-analogue of the classical A + T1 + H with dims 1,3,5 established in PR #4506.

assertions.name: classical_limit_is_dimension_ratio
assertions.source: THE FALSIFIABLE CHECK. The q-dimension mix W_A : W_H = [1]_q : [5]_q must degenerate at q -> 1 to the classical dimension ratio 1 : 5, i.e. 1/6 : 5/6 — exactly the classical projector-trace weights of PR #4506. It does. The weighting was fixed before evaluation, so this is a check, not a tuning.

assertions.name: mix_normalised
assertions.source: The derived I=0 channel weights sum to 1, as a normalised weight system must.

description: Bean qou-63n2 continuation: fixes the LAST free parameter of the color-tube weight tensor W. Chain: 8 free params (bare) -> 2 (color side, T1 (x) T1 = A + T1 + H, PR #4506) -> 1 (isospin selection forces I=1 onto T1, leaving only the I=0 deuteron channel's A/H mix, PR #4510) -> 0 (this probe). The q-deformed Clebsch-Gordan [3]_q^2 = [1]_q + [3]_q + [5]_q is exact (verified symbolically), so the isotypic summands carry quantum dimensions [1],[3],[5]; weighting by quantum dimension — the canonical categorical/q-Plancherel measure the corpus uses elsewhere — fixes the I=0 mix as W_A : W_H = [1]_q : [5]_q, a function of q alone with NO free parameter. FALSIFIABLE CHECK (not tuned): at q -> 1 the mix must degenerate to the classical dimension ratio 1/6 : 5/6, and it does. THE ONE ASSUMPTION, NAMED: that the weighting is by QUANTUM rather than classical dimension — canonical in a quantum-group setting, but a choice, so the derivation is 'modulo the q-dimension weighting', not unconditional. STRICT anti-fit: the deuteron binding is NOT an input; with the mix derived it becomes an independent check for a later probe. Nothing wired.
